title: Search sites
statement: A site is one of the following: marking an initial code, reading the mark of $U$ in a relaxation round, reading the mark of $V$ in a relaxation round, marking $V$ in a relaxation round, reading the mark of $U$ in the count, or reading the mark of $U$ in the final scan. Each of the first five kinds of site carries a Boolean parameter; the final-scan site carries none.
